title: Market Day
description: Linh and her mum go to the market for a special dinner.
instructions: Read about Linh at the market. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🛒 Every Sunday morning, Linh goes to the market with her mum. Today they went early because it was a special day. It was her father's birthday.
The market was busy and noisy. Sellers shouted, 'Fresh fish! Cheap vegetables!' Linh liked the colours of the fruit.
First, they bought a big fish for dinner. It cost fifty thousand dong. Then they bought some tomatoes, onions and a bag of rice.
Linh saw a stall with beautiful flowers. She chose yellow flowers for her dad. They were not expensive, so her mum bought a bunch.
Suddenly, it started to rain. People ran under the roofs and Linh and her mum waited for ten minutes. A woman gave Linh a banana.
At eleven o'clock, they went home by bus. Linh's dad was waiting at the door. He smiled when he saw the flowers. 'Thank you, Linh,' he said.
